trap.label: oração relativa
trap.wrong: The teacher who she helped me is kind. The class that I loved it was fun. The town where I lived there is small.
trap.right: The teacher who helped me is kind. The class that I loved was fun. The town where I lived is small.
trap.why: O português tolera o pronome repetido (“a professora que ela me ajudou”). Em inglês, who/that/where já substituem o sujeito/objeto/lugar; repetir she, it ou there é erro.

opts: The man who he called is my uncle.
The man what called is my uncle.
The man who called is my uncle.

fix.wrong: The book that I read it was good.
fix.right: The book that I read was good.

fix.wrong: The girl who she sings is my friend.
fix.right: The girl who sings is my friend.

fix.wrong: The cafe where we met there is closed.
fix.right: The cafe where we met is closed.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “I know a teacher. She helped me.” (who)
rewrite.answer: I know a teacher who helped me.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “This is the class. I loved it.” (that)
rewrite.answer: This is the class that I loved.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “That is the town. I lived there.” (where)
rewrite.answer: That is the town where I lived.
